name: Documenso
title: Documenso: free DocuSign alternative
hook: DocuSign charges you eleven bucks a month to get documents signed online. This app does it for free.

features.intro: Send contracts for signing in minutes.
features.say: Upload a PDF, add your signers, and place their signature fields.
Each signer gets an email with a button to sign the document.
Then track who has signed from one dashboard.

install_line: It runs in any browser. Nothing to install.
caption:
DocuSign charges $11/month to get documents signed online. Documenso does it for free ✍️

✅ Upload a PDF, add signers and signature fields
✅ Signers get an email with a button to sign
✅ Track who has signed from one dashboard
✅ No subscription, no credit card, free to start

💻 Any browser
ℹ️ The free hosted plan includes 5 documents per month, the same as DocuSign Personal's 5 envelopes per month. You can also self-host it. DocuSign's $11/month is Personal billed annually

Comment "SIGN" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
